notes: What game are we playing? is a wheel of eight: Magic and D&D on top, Yu-Gi-Oh, Lorcana, Riftbound, Pokemon TCG, Flesh and Blood and Altered round it -- at boot, from the chip above START, from SYSTEM > GAME
The other games are life counters with their own numbers: Yu-Gi-Oh 8000 LP by 50, Lorcana first to 20 lore, Riftbound first to 8, Pokemon 6 prizes, Flesh and Blood 40 or 20, Altered first to 7
SETUP > Font: Beleren, Lemon Milk, Arena or Norway for the names, titles and numerals (Arena and Norway borrow numerals)
A (?) at the top of the Magic face opens HOW TO PLAY; SETUP > Help on face hides it
Quick Start: LTD is called BASIC; the partner (+) asks NEW NAME or LIST
